Record Class TestRunRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.dev.test.TestRunRequest
Record Components:
runId - The run's identifier, for the events
classLoader - The loader of the test classes and the classes under test: a generation's loader in development mode. It is the thread context loader while the run lasts
testClassOutputs - The directories holding the compiled tests
testSources - The test source roots, for runners that select by file
selection - Which tests run
parameters - The runner's configuration, from the manifest
public record TestRunRequest(String runId, ClassLoader classLoader, List<Path> testClassOutputs, List<SourceRoot> testSources, TestSelection selection, Map<String,String> parameters) extends Record
What a runner runs.
